title: ECCITE-seq
scope: Mimitou 2019 ECCITE-seq implementation; retain reported multimodal reporters and library branches. Extract the middle ECCITE-Seq row only. The neighboring CITE-seq/CROP-Seq rows, right-side chemical illustrations and QR code are context, not additional targets or connected reactions. A/B/C denote independently hashtag-labeled sample populations; no species or guide status is inferred for a letter. Guide capture applies to guide-expressing cells when the scaffold RT primer is included. Primary evidence resolves the 5P capture interface, reaction order, antibody linkage and library routing; TCR branches are retained as reported implementation components rather than extra target methods.

method_scopes.rationale: All operations implement the scoped multimodal ECCITE-seq architecture. The three staining instances retain the independently routed sample preparations and combine the two antibody-labeling purposes without inventing a relative staining order. Cell Hashing, CITE-seq-derived antibody tagging and the 10× V(D)J workflow are components. Primary full text explicitly supports direct sgRNA capture and the transcriptome, TCR α/β, TCR γ/δ, protein-tag, hashtag and guide-tag library branches. This is an implementation-level graph, not a claim that every ECCITE-seq experiment includes guides or both TCR branches.
